title: Kala-Deeksha
SubTitle: Free Art Education Centers
Description: Kala Deeksha is an initiative by Kalantar to impart free art education to under privileged children, youth & women. The institute is running its centres at various government primary schools as well as self-owned centres. Students from Kala Deeksha have won various prizes at various levels in the country. May it be a slum or a prison, an orphanage school or an underprivileged society, an under-construction site or a begger on a street, Kala-Deeksha is a place where people from any such place can come over and take free art classes. Art is a tool to ease mind and we believe that this tool must be given to everyone in the society.

title: Karagaar Ke Kalaakar
SubTitle: From Prisons To Positivity
Description: “No one is a born criminal; crimes take birth in heart with uncontrolled emotions or a controlled mind”. With this statement of Sri Vishal Srivastava (the chairman), Kalantar Art Foundation is committed to positively engage the prison inmates in practising various art forms. This, not only will help them bring positivity in their minds rather will also help them in getting a right path for their livelihood once they are out from the prison boundaries.

title: Art Villages
SubTitle: A Social Revolution
Description: The concept of Art Village is one-of-its-kind and being implemented 1st time in India by Kalantar Art Foundation. The cultural heritage of India is considered to be the oldest one in the world. Somehow, with increasing craze of modernity we are missing out our own culture. Art Village is a concept where each house of the village will have atleast one artist practising one of the 64 traits of artform mentioned in the Veda. By doing this, not only the families will get a positive aura and a source of earning by way of art, but also we will be able to achieve a better society and a better world.

title: Colors of the Corporate
SubTitle: Art Based Behavioural Trainings
Description: A corporate working environment is full of working challenges – peer to peer challenge, supervisor-subordinate challenge, pressure of targets, team conflicts etc. People at every level need formal training on behavioural aspects and interpersonal skills. Colours of the Corporates is an initiative by Kalantar to enhance the behavioural skills of the corporate people by customizing art-based trainings on various behavioural aspects in the corporate scenario. It is not just helpful for the corporates to make a better work environment but also of great help for improving employees’ personal traits.

title: Annual Art Festival
SubTitle: Celebration of Art
Description: Kalantar’s Annual Art Festivals are well known across the country. Through these highly engaging online events, the organization has been able to motivate people from prisons, old age homes, orphanages, women shelter alongwith all the privileged schools and colleges. Earlier these Art Festivals used to be in offline mode. But, after COVID we started with online events, which became a huge success with participation of as much as fifty thoiusand participants from across the country.

title: 64 Traits of Art
SubTitle: Celebration of Art
Description: Kalantar has always endeavoured to revive the forgotten art, culture and tradition of the country, that we proudly call “Sanatan Bharat”. From our studies we have learned that there are 64 art forms mentioned in the Veda. It is also believed that each one of us have atleast one of these art forms within us. Now, it is up to us if we want it to remain slept deep within us or we want to exploit the same for betterment of our own selves as well as for betterment of society on large. In various ways Kalantar is trying to spread this concept, so that people can do a self-realization of the art within them and practice it for themselves.
